subject.title: feat(teams-meetings): join Microsoft Teams meetings via the meeting-bot core

question: Should this bundled plugin land before a real Teams guest join and Google Meet recovery run demonstrate the browser and audio paths?
rationale: Mocks cannot establish Microsoft Teams' current DOM, tenant interstitial, lobby, permission, or audio-device behavior, and accepting that uncertainty for a bundled plugin requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Fix the secret-input contract, then capture redacted Teams join/audio/leave evidence and a Google Meet recovery regression run against the reviewed head.

options.title: Accept an experimental bundle
options.body: Land the disabled plugin while explicitly accepting that its browser selectors and shared recovery path have not been demonstrated against real services.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Fix the secret-input contract, then capture redacted Teams join/audio/leave evidence and a Google Meet recovery regression run against the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared adapter architecture and have the strongest recent ownership signal for the affected meeting paths.
